description: This source file defines an enumeration OutputFormat that specifies different output formats (txt and srt) for transcript processing. It includes methods to determine if audio time ranges are needed for the format and a method to generate text content from attributed transcript data, formatting it accordingly for each output type.

methods.name: needsAudioTimeRange
methods.description: Computed property that indicates whether the output format requires audio time range information.

methods.name: text(for: maxLength:)
methods.description: Generates formatted text from an attributed transcript, outputting plain text for txt format or SRT subtitles for srt format, with optional length limiting.

search-terms: srt and txt formatting in Swift
